execution.description: Ran Cooling PB-ADV over a four-design by two-condition analytical fixture with K=2 through both the fixed-grid baseline and the registered challenge-neutral coarse-to-fine method.

expected: Both methods would serve PB-ADV without the former pb_adv_not_served error and would return at most K exact point proposals with binding-constraint evidence.
observed: Both methods returned two point proposals after eight attempted model evaluations, and every fixed-grid proposal carried its recomputable binding constraint. No reference campaign or paid compute ran.
keep: Use the same SearchAdapter and registered method implementation for Cooling Mode X rather than adding a Cooling branch to shared search code.
